items: 8 g miso paste OR 1/2 tsp salt

steps: Preheat your oven to 240 C or 220 C (fan/convection)

Microwave cream cheese & miso in 30 seconds to 1-minute intervals, whisking in between, until softened. Alternatively, you can also use a double boiler or just letting your cream cheese come to room temperature. However, heating will help melt down the cream cheese so you won’t need to use an electric mixer or whisking too long which will incorporate too much air in the batter, resulting in a deflated airy cheesecake. Whisking just enough with the right speed, we will get a creamy cheesecake in the denser side!
Whisk by hand until very smooth without lumps.
Mix the egg first, then pour in while whisking.
Add heavy cream, whisk until incorporated.

Line a 16-cm springform pan. Cut a circle for the base and a long rectangle for the sides. This way, your cheesecake will come out a neat circle. If you prefer the rustic look, line your pan by pressing a huge baking paper to fit the shape of the pan.
Bake for 30-40 minutes or 21-25 minutes for fan/convection. Baking time really does vary between ovens, so watch your cheesecake!! We want a dark brown top that is still very jiggly.
Cool down to room temperature and refrigerate for at couple hours or overnight before slicing. Do not slice right away please, be patient it’s worth it!!
